keys.manual_player.page.title: XIRO! - Player's Manual
keys.manual_player.hero.title: Player's Manual
keys.manual_player.hero.subtitle: Everything you need to know to play XIRO!
keys.manual_player.join.s1.title: Go to xiro.pro
keys.manual_player.join.s1.text:
Open the browser on your phone or tablet and go to xiro.pro.

You can also scan the QR code on screen.
keys.manual_player.join.s2.title: Enter the Session ID
keys.manual_player.join.s2.text: Tap «Player» and enter the PIN code shown on the presenter's screen (e.g. XXXXXX-XXXX).
keys.manual_player.join.s3.title: Choose your name
keys.manual_player.join.s3.text: Type your name or nickname (max. 15 characters). It will appear in the final ranking.
keys.manual_player.join.s4.title: Select a team
keys.manual_player.join.s4.text: (Optional) If the game is team-based, you will be asked which team to join. Tap your team!
keys.manual_player.join.s5.title: Wait and play!
keys.manual_player.join.s5.text:
Your name will appear on screen. When «START» is pressed you will see a countdown.

Speed earns bonus points!
keys.manual_player.answer.section.title: Question Types
keys.manual_player.answer.section.subtitle: There are different answer mechanics. Learn how each one works!
keys.manual_player.answer.quiz.title: Quiz
keys.manual_player.answer.quiz.text: You will see 2 to 4 coloured buttons. Tap the one you think is correct as fast as possible. Only one answer is valid.
keys.manual_player.answer.quiz_img.title: Image Quiz
keys.manual_player.answer.quiz_img.text: Same as the regular quiz, but the question includes a photo or image to decipher.
keys.manual_player.answer.quiz_music.title: Music Quiz
keys.manual_player.answer.quiz_music.text: Listen carefully. A musical clip will play in the room or on your phone. Guess what it is.
keys.manual_player.answer.survey.title: Survey
keys.manual_player.answer.survey.text: Shows multiple options. There are no right or wrong answers. Your vote contributes to the final statistics.
keys.manual_player.answer.multiple.title: Multiple Choice
keys.manual_player.answer.multiple.text: Between 1 and 6 answers are correct. Check all the ones you think are valid and tap Confirm.
keys.manual_player.answer.numeric.title: Numeric Estimate
keys.manual_player.answer.numeric.text: Guess an exact number. Enter on your numeric keypad the value you think is closest to the correct answer.
keys.manual_player.answer.order.title: Order
keys.manual_player.answer.order.text: Drag and sort the options to form the correct sequence. When ready, tap Confirm Order.
keys.manual_player.answer.scramble.title: Word Scramble
keys.manual_player.answer.scramble.text: Tap the letters in the correct order to reveal the hidden word before the other players.
keys.manual_player.answer.matching.title: Matching
keys.manual_player.answer.matching.text: You will see two columns. The left is fixed; drag the items on the right to place each one in front of its correct pair. Tap Confirm when ready. You earn points for each correct match!
keys.manual_player.score.section.title: Scoring & Streaks
keys.manual_player.score.section.subtitle: Answer fast and don't miss to maximise your points.
keys.manual_player.score.streak_section.title: Streak Multipliers
keys.manual_player.score.exact.title: Exact Hit
keys.manual_player.score.exact.text: Green screen. Correct answer, perfect numeric estimate or exact order! You earn maximum points.
keys.manual_player.score.approx.title: Approximate Hit
keys.manual_player.score.approx.text: Yellow screen. Your estimate or sequence order was very close. You receive a partial score.
keys.manual_player.score.fail.title: Miss
keys.manual_player.score.fail.text: Red screen. Wrong answer or out of time. No points earned in that round.
keys.manual_player.score.streak.title: Streak
keys.manual_player.score.streak.text: Answering correctly several times in a row activates a Streak and your points per question are multiplied by an extra bonus.
keys.manual_player.score.double.title: Double Streak
keys.manual_player.score.double.text: Keep the streak even longer without missing and you level up — the bonus increases. The longer you last, the more you earn!
keys.manual_player.trivial.section.title: Trivial Mechanics
keys.manual_player.trivial.section.subtitle: Sometimes the game takes place on an animated board. Here's how it works:
keys.manual_player.trivial.s1.title: Roll the dice
keys.manual_player.trivial.s1.text: The system or the presenter rolls the dice on the main board to determine how many squares the piece advances.
keys.manual_player.trivial.s2.title: Choose the square
keys.manual_player.trivial.s2.text: The piece advances to a specific square on the board. The colour of the square indicates the category.
keys.manual_player.trivial.s3.title: Answer the question
keys.manual_player.trivial.s3.text: All players are shown a random question based on the category of the square landed on. Time to answer!
